cause: Mistaken empty --overlay parsed as current directory, so PCK load failed and phase expectations did not apply. Source candidate and formal packs unchanged. A later command could not see the old runner PID from its separate process namespace; no signal was sent by that command. Runner owns a 300-second timeout.
termination: Original exec session interrupted by Ctrl-C; tool returned exit_code 130. No retry of a signal to an unverified PID.
